Erase Current Deck
Erase the current deck from the spacecraft design. All rooms and equipment on the current deck will be erased.

Erase Room
Erases entire rooms from the current deck when you click in them.

Move/Copy Rooms And Equipment
Moves rooms and equipment of the entire design or the current deck.
Copies rooms and equipment of the current deck.

Burn CD
Store the spacecraft design onto a disk. You must have a blank data disk in your inventory.

Depart Studio
Depart the spacecraft design studio. Your avatar emerges at the site of the design studio building.

Move Grid Up
Move the design grid to the next deck aloft.

Move Grid Down
Move the design grid to the next deck below.

Streamline Hull
Hull streamlining enables greater velocity when maneuvering within an atmosphere. Streamlining increases spacecraft mass by 10%.

System Modules
Configure modules for most systems. The modules for medical units and turrets are selected when they are placed.

Check Paths
Tests paths through the design. Displays a report of the results.

Tech Level
Applies a minimum value to the tech level of the design. Configures the design for manufacturing at a higher tech level than the design requires due to its armor, equipment, and size.

Lateral Grid Lines
Enable grid lines on the beam.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the port quarter.

Longitudinal Grid Lines
Enable grid lines fore and aft.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the starboard quarter.

Render Mode
Switch view between line drawing or solid rendering.

Increase Room Number
Increases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Decrease Room Number
Decreases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Room Number
Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Push this button to change the room number of an existing room to the number shown. The room number cannot change if this would create two rooms of the same type with the same room number on the same deck.

Erase Room Cells
Erases room cells from the current deck of the design.

Erase Equipment
Erase equipment one unit at a time.

Erase Equipment in Area
Erase equipment in a brush-sized area. Only equipment that is the same type and in the same room as the equipment at the click location is erased.

Increase Brush Size
Increase the brush size for drawing and erasing equipment.

Decrease Brush Size
Decrease the brush size for drawing and erasing equipment.

Brush Size
Size of brush used for drawing and erasing equipment.
When drawing, equipment fills the brush area in the room at the click location. Only certain types of equipment fills an area of a room.
When erasing, only equipment that is the same type and in the same room as the equipment at the click location is erased from the brush area.

Increase Hull Armor
Increase the hull armor level. Improves defense against physical damage and increases spacecraft mass.

Decrease Hull Armor
Decrease the hull armor level. Reduces defense against physical damage and decreases spacecraft mass.

offline_spacecraft_help.value: - All the buttons on this window have tooltips.
- Start by painting the floor of a room, such as the Bridge.
- Move the design grid up and down using buttons on this window.
- Add equipment by clicking a location on the floor.
- Rotate beds and vehicles with arrow keys while placing them.
- A hatch or turret is placed in the ceiling by raising the design grid and placing the hatch on the story above.
- A station is made by keeping the gravity drive acceleration very low.

- Room identifier distinguishes between different rooms of the same type on the same deck. To make two staterooms on the same deck, change the room id before painting the second stateroom. Room id can be the same on different decks. e.g. Deck 1 can have stateroom 4 and deck 2 can also have stateroom 4.
1. Check Paths to find routing conditions that may need attention.
3. Walk through the design to be sure every room can be accessed.
4. Save the design to a file.
5. Go to a design studio in the game and load the design from the file. Save the design into the spacecraft design library.

6. Store the design onto a blank disk in your inventory using the Burn CD button. The design studio sells blank disks from the city's inventory. THE BURN CD BUTTON IS ONLY VISIBLE IF THE DESIGN IS VALID AND SAVED.
7. Take the design disk to a spacecraft factory for manufacturing.
8. Publish a spacecraft design by selling a design disk to a design studio. You earn an architect commission whenever your designs are manufactured.
